notes.title: v0.1 Released!
notes.content:
🌀 Version 0.1 Now Available on Steam!

We’re excited to announce that Apocalypse of the Universe (v0.1) is now live on Steam!


Step into a world consumed by darkness, where portals to demonic realms have shattered the land. In this 2D platformer adventure, you play as an elven warrior on a desperate mission to save his homeland from total annihilation.

⚔ What Awaits You:
Challenging platforming through corrupted lands filled with traps, enemies, and secrets

Dynamic combat with a magical bow, melee attacks, and upgradeable abilities

Epic boss battles — defeat the gatekeepers and seal the demonic rifts

Exploration & progression — unlock hidden paths, solve puzzles, and level up your hero

Beautiful pixel art in a dark fantasy world

Lore-rich storytelling with cinematic moments and mysterious fragments of the past

Version 0.1 marks the first public release — a solid foundation with core mechanics, combat, and several regions to explore. Your feedback will help shape what’s to come!

🛡️ Ready to fight back against the darkness?
Download now on Steam and join the resistance.


🌑 The fate of the world rests in your hands.

notes.title: 🌙 Apocalypse of the Universe – Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
🌙 APOCALYPSE OF THE UNIVERSE: DEMO EVENT AT STEAM NEXT FEST
Join us for Steam Next Fest and get a first look at Apocalypse of the Universe!
As part of the festival, you'll be able to try out the demo version of the game, where you’ll step into the role of an elven hero fighting back against a demonic invasion and attempting to save their homeland from cursed portals.

In this special preview, you will:

Play through the first story level and battle demons at the portal,

Engage in a tense boss fight,

Try out the hero’s magical bow, special abilities, and upgrade system.
[hr][/hr]🗓️ HOW TO PARTICIPATE
Head over to the Apocalypse of the Universe page on Steam and download the demo.

Launch the game — the main menu will display the schedule of upcoming gameplay sessions.

The first event begins on Monday, June 9th. Check the schedule and don’t miss it — events run during set time slots!
[hr][/hr]🔍 WHAT TO EXPECT
Tight, action-packed platforming with traps, secrets, and precise movement,

Combat mechanics including bow attacks, special skills, stat upgrades, and power-ups,

An epic boss battle that sets the stage for the campaign,

Immersive atmosphere with pixel art, moody sound design, and scattered lore fragments.
[hr][/hr]🌟 THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING
This demo is only the first chapter of a much larger adventure.
The full version launches on June 19th, 2025, featuring an expansive single-player campaign with exploration, progression, and survival in a dark, demon-infested fantasy world.
[hr][/hr]🚀 JUMP IN NOW
The demo has been available since May 17th, 2025 — you can play it today!

The first Steam Next Fest event kicks off on June 9th.

Events will take place in timed sessions, updated through the game’s main menu.

Grab your bow, unlock your powers, and close the portals.
The silent moon calls — and only you can save this world.
[hr][/hr]
Let me know if you'd like this formatted for Steam, social media, or as a press release!
